item.title: NVIDIA DCGM User Guide
item.description: 1. What DCGM Is DCGM (Data Center GPU Manager) is a toolset NVIDIA provides for managing and monitoring GPUs in the data center. It offers the following capabilities: GPU behavior monitoring GPU configuration management GPU policy supervision GPU health and diagnostics GPU accounting and process statistics NVSwitch configuration and monitoring
